items.title: The category of filtered objects is additive with kernels and cokernels but is not abelian
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma lists the categorical properties of the category of filtered objects of an abelian category: it is additive, has a zero object, has kernels, cokernels, images and coimages, but is not abelian in general (statement lines 4927-4938). The proof is a complete argument: the direct sum with its componentwise filtration gives additivity (proof lines 4941-4944); the kernel with the induced filtration and the cokernel with the quotient filtration are exhibited, which also provides images and coimages (proof lines 4945-4949); and the failure of abelianness is delegated to a named example (proof lines 4950-4952). The non-formal content is the identification of the kernels and cokernels with the induced and quotient filtrations. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
